_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Checking the name against the register

description: Checks whether a proposed name for a NEW New York LLC or PLLC is free on the state's live register, the way the Department of State compares names (ignoring case, punctuation, the LLC ending and a leading 'The'). Returns the name as it would be filed, whether it is taken, and similar existing names. Advisory: the Department of State has the final word. Use when someone is choosing a name or planning to form an LLC.

kind.description: llc (default) or pllc for licensed professions.

name.description: The proposed name, with or without LLC at the end.

name: check_llc_name_availability
title: Check a new LLC name
